items.claim: Installed bond/seam mass and capacity are not contained by an evidenced 5% allowance.
items.needed_to_ground: Ground first: weigh and load a representative curved two-skin/core seam with the intended film coverage, seal, manufacturing defects and post-thermal-cycle condition. Establish seam buckling, shear/peel and leak behavior.
items.effect_on_lead: The optimistic selected joint already consumes more than the payload; redesign or a much lighter demonstrated joint is needed. Cases are not bounding tests.

items.claim: Maximum currently purchasable 0.75-0.79 mm panel size and installed shape are UNKNOWN.
items.needed_to_ground: Ground second, with material NFI: obtain a supplier-confirmed grade/gauge/size/flatness specification, formed-panel gauge map and curvature survey. Measure edge and joint steps; establish trim yield.
items.effect_on_lead: Thinner-size maximum is unspecified. Uniform upper tolerance adds 472.40 kg faces; low-gauge wrinkle SF is 0.52323. Flatness measured restrained cannot qualify assembled buckling.

items.claim: S200F bulk properties are not an established rolled SR200, formed and joined, biaxial compression basis.
items.needed_to_ground: Measure rolled-direction/transverse compression, biaxial behavior, through-thickness/peel response and post-form/post-join properties. Resolve grade, heat treatment, gauge length and guide/datasheet discrepancies.
items.effect_on_lead: Current E alone gives SF 0.63631. Neither 241 MPa tensile floor nor 283 MPa inherited value is a guaranteed current SR200 compression minimum.

items.claim: Daily thermal-cycle life of the pressure-loaded Be/HRH10 joint is UNKNOWN.
items.needed_to_ground: Measure effective directional core/face/adhesive expansion, service temperature histories, restraint and fatigue under representative compressive mean load. Test the assumed 10,958 daily cycles if a 30-year target is adopted.
items.effect_on_lead: 016 concerned SiC/PVC; only its scalar equation is reused. Gc is not shear strength. The upper elastic thermal screen may exceed yield; no fatigue margin or life can be inferred.

items.claim: K13D2U QI epoxy is the best inherited Be-free candidate, but its laminate and joint basis remain assumptions.
items.needed_to_ground: Ground the I014b QI laminate compression/stiffness/density and manufacturing route, then use the same evidenced joint mass and geometry for Be and composite. Do not substitute single-fiber moduli.
items.effect_on_lead: Preserves a relatively small equal-budget trade but cannot promise a direct drop-in result. M55J is weaker in the published comparison; AlBeMet retains 62 wt% Be.

items.claim: Finished-sheet capacity, current S200F/SR200 prices and fabrication yields are UNKNOWN.
items.needed_to_ground: Obtain grade/gauge/size-specific lot quotations, lead time, rolling capacity, scrap recovery and installed-panel yield. No vendor contact or purchase was made in this task.
items.effect_on_lead: USGS $1600/kg is contained Be in copper master alloy. Multipliers are owner stress cases, not supplier prices or confidence intervals. Mine-output shares do not prove availability.

items.claim: Controlled fabrication costs are an explicit open procurement item.
items.needed_to_ground: Specify jurisdiction and process steps; get a contractor quote including enclosure/extraction or wet processing, exposure assessment, waste/hygiene and surveillance obligations. Price F and C separately.
items.effect_on_lead: Adds process and capital burdens without stopping this estimate card. Cost multipliers are assumptions, not OSHA charges or a substitute for the actual exposure-control specification.

items.claim: Crimp-branch gamma=1, stabilised Ec in wrinkling and common nu remain unvalidated inherited assumptions.
items.needed_to_ground: Resolve the inherited MAINLINE-018 crimp-step and core-modulus questions using their owning evidence; this manufacturing card does not adjudicate them.
items.effect_on_lead: No source or manufacturing result here establishes SF 1. Branch transitions can sharply affect direct substitutions; do not blindly scale every mode with kd.

mass_correction.note: The pinned 009c5 other branch has faces about 2044 kg but much lower SF. It may explain the brief figure, but its origin is not established. Use actual leading-point mass.
